csv_project_name: Consultant for National Capital Region Freight Plan
csv_scope_of_work: COG/TPB is seeking a consultant or consultant team to support an update to the National Capital Region Freight Plan. The selected Consultant will have expertise on the topics of freight planning/goods movement in general and specifically on public sector freight plan creation. The Statement of Work for the plan update is intended to fulfill the following objectives: Update the National Capital Region Freight Plan (Freight Plan), including an Executive Summary and other visualizations appropriate for policy level readers; Specify the types of data and sources that are recommended to be used to develop the plan; Conduct freight-related analyses that includes analysis of existing freight travel by mode, estimation of truck origin-destination trip movements, and forecasts of future freight demand; Address any federally-specified freight plan elements that are appropriate for a region-level plan (see U.S. Department of Transportation, Guidance on Multimodal State Freight Plans and State Freight Advisory Committees, February 2026); Provide updated information on a range of freight policy issues, including implications for the TPB region and member jurisdictions; Summarize the value of the freight transportation network to the region s economic growth and competitiveness; Support stakeholder engagement for the Freight Plan update; and Develop electronic/on-line information to highlight Freight Plan findings and analysis in the form of a ArcGIS Story map and/or interactive dashboard.
csv_disciplines_requested: Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Public Transit Planning, Transportation Planning

short_description: Consultancy to update the regional freight plan for Washington, DC.

project_scope: Update of the National Capital Region Freight Plan, including executive summary and policy-level visualizations; specification of recommended data types and sources; freight analyses covering existing freight travel by mode, truck origin-destination movements, and future freight demand forecasts; consideration of applicable federal freight plan elements; updated assessment of freight policy issues and regional implications; summary of the freight network's economic value; stakeholder engagement support; and development of online outputs such as an ArcGIS StoryMap and/or interactive dashboard.
services: Freight planning consultancy services, transportation planning, public transit planning, land use/planning support, stakeholder engagement, data analysis, forecasting, and digital information/visualization development.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure freight and transportation planning consultancy.
- No bridge, building, roof, special structure, or structural engineering scope.
- Falls under planning/consulting rather than design of load-bearing structures.
- Explicitly outside sbp core focus on structural and bridge engineering.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction works are included. This is a planning/consultancy assignment for a regional freight plan update, so no construction cost is stated or realistically derivable from the notice.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the notice. As this is a general planning consultancy unrelated to sbp's core structural services, no meaningful sbp fee estimate can be derived.
references_qualifications: Consultant or consultant team with expertise in freight planning/goods movement and specifically in public-sector freight plan creation.
